The survey distinguishes support needs, functional level of disability and meeting the definition of disability. These are three related but not interchangeable indicators.
The three figures use functional definitions from the Australian survey. Support need, severe/profound disability and meeting the definition of disability are not identical categories.
The survey’s functional categories should not be treated as if they were clinical diagnoses.
